verdict.rationale: EBANX's marketing site says merchants can make payments in 'single or mass payouts', which is the product's own bulk capability for disbursements. It is a single thin marketing mention, with no documentation of batch endpoints, limits, or bulk handling for other item types such as refunds or captures. Missing for 10: documented bulk/batch API endpoints, bulk operations beyond payouts (refunds, captures, chargebacks), limits and error handling for batches, independent or hands-on corroboration.
